execution_bootstrap.verifier_location: The verifier derives every live root from realpath(import.meta.url); only the overlay root is supplied.
execution_bootstrap.host_runtime: The invoking Node/V8 binary is an environment receipt, not a byte-reproducible candidate identity. Its executable path and versions are emitted; a host-runtime change invalidates the run but does not alter candidate source identity.

typescript_closure.ledger_scope: Every canonical regular file under the installed TypeScript package, including package.json, lib/typescript.js, bin/tsc, lib/tsc.js, declarations, libraries, notices, and locale data. Path-set and every byte are revalidated; symlinks and unsupported entries reject.
typescript_closure.ast_implementation: The verifier imports the exact ledger-verified node_modules/typescript/lib/typescript.js by canonical file URL only after the complete package verifies.
typescript_closure.typecheck_implementation: Candidate typecheck invokes the exact ledger-verified node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc with --project mirror/tsconfig.apotheosis.json --noEmit. The generic .bin shim is not part of the claim.
typescript_closure.config_closure: The child must extend ./tsconfig.json and the exact parent must not extend another config. Both canonical files and hashes are verified.

live_root_binding.canonicality: Every derived directory/file and overlay root must equal its canonical real path. Symbolic links below active grammar, dependency, tool, or overlay roots are rejected.
live_root_binding.caller_arguments: Only the candidate overlay root is caller-supplied; mirror, clean base, package, lock, configurations, dependency, tool, and ledger roots cannot be substituted.

mechanical_checks: clean-base manifest matches and active grammar contains zero TypeScript sources before overlay
overlay is one canonical regular UTF-8 file at the exact target path
TypeScript syntax parses and exactly one direct variable named numberStart is exported; export declarations, assignments, and other exported declarations are rejected

the exact AST visitor rejects dynamic import/require, runtime template expressions, binary-plus coercion, element access, object binding/spread, imperative loops, the verifier's enumerated direct identifiers/properties, and the literal source-property spelling
all 64 installed parse-that dist paths/bytes plus installed package.json are revalidated
all 130 installed TypeScript package paths/bytes, package name/version, both TypeScript configs, mirror package, and lock are revalidated
source, overlay-ledger, projected one-file grammar-ledger, clean-base, parse-that aggregate, TypeScript aggregate/config closure, resolved roots, and host runtime receipt are emitted
mechanical_nonclaims: The AST visitor does not claim to recognize token/atom/component-value/CST naming.
It does not inspect regex-literal breadth or prove bounded matching.
It does not prove absence of aliases, indirection, recursion, prototype/inherited coercion, source derivation, scanner behavior, or contrivance.
It does not prove idiomatic parse-that, normative ownership, O(1), or KISS.
human_review_boundary: Every one of the five independent exact-source skeptics must inspect every candidate for token/CST architecture, regex breadth, all indirection and source-derivation routes, scanner/remainder behavior, predecessor dependence, state corruption, normative ownership, O(1), LOC/KISS, and idiomatic direct parse-that. A mechanical pass is necessary only and grants no safety or idiom credit.
typecheck: After overlay identities close, run the emitted direct canonical Node + bound TypeScript bin/tsc command against the exact two-file config closure. The ordinary npm run check remains a formation-level regression witness, not the identity of the candidate-specific command.
projection: The active base ledger is empty. The overlay ledger and projected active grammar ledger are the same single canonical row `<source-sha256><two spaces>grammar/css/l4/value-unit/number-start.ts<LF>`.
integration: After quintet and triumvirate, copy only exact selected bytes into mirror/apotheosis/target_path, require the emitted projected hash, then rerun type, semantic, fresh holdout, hostile, and benchmark evidence. This remains prototype integration, never production execution.
drift_rule: Any public input, verifier bytes/location, resolved live root, host-runtime receipt, clean-base file/census, package/lock/config, parse-that byte, TypeScript ledger/path/byte, source, overlay, or projected identity drift starts a new promotion generation.
